title: EICMA 2026: Hero Xpulse 450 Unveiled; Dakar Experience Comes to the Road
text:
EICMA 2026: Hero Xpulse 450 Unveiled; Dakar Experience Comes to the Road - BikeWale 
 Log In AD EICMA 2026: Hero Xpulse 450 Unveiled; Dakar Experience Comes to the Road
 Abhijeet Singh November 03, 2026, 06:46 PM IST 2,371 Views Powered by an all-new 421cc single-cylinder engine
 Developed using learnings from Hero MotoSports' Dakar Rally programme
 Will compete with the Royal Enfield Himalayan 450 and KTM 390 Adventure 
 Hero MotoCorp has unveiled the new Xpulse 450 at EICMA 2026 entiering into the increasingly competitive middleweight adventure motorcycle segment. This new model is powered by a 421cc single-cylinder engine and has been developed using learnings from the company's international rally racing programme, including the Dakar Rally. Xpulse 450 represents a considerable step forward from the existing Xpulse 210.
 Until now, the manufacturer has largely concentrated on smaller-capacity motorcycles that favour manageable weight, accessible performance and off-road ability. The existing Xpulse 210 follows this formula with its 210cc liquid-cooled engine producing 24bhp and 20.7Nm. However, the introduction of the new 421cc engine moves the Xpulse family into a considerably more demanding category where buyers expect a motorcycle to be equally comfortable on highways and challenging trails.
 Hero has drawn upon the experience accumulated through its Hero MotoSports Team Rally programme. The manufacturer's participation in international rally events, particularly the Dakar Rally, has provided valuable knowledge about motorcycle durability, suspension behaviour, weight distribution and rider ergonomics. The Xpulse 450 is intended to benefit from this experience, although the company has not yet explained which specific components or engineering solutions have been carried over from its rally motorcycles.
 For the Indian market, the Xpulse 450 enters a segment that already busy. The Royal Enfield Himalayan 450 has established itself as a versatile adventure tourer, KTM 390 Adventure offers a more performance-oriented package with extensive electronic equipment, and the Norton Atlas will soon be here as well. Hero will therefore need to find a balance between outright performance, off-road capability, practical features and pricing.
